mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.name, r.status, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT rp.permission_code ORDER BY rp.permission_code) AS permissions, COUNT(DISTINCT er.employee_id) AS employee_count FROM s_venue_role r LEFT JOIN s_venue_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id LEFT JOIN s_employee_role er ON er.role_id = r.id WHERE r.venue_id = #{venueId} GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.status ORDER BY r.id
